name: lion_a
note: ONE sample first (owner rule): the palace stone lion. Bare geometry; klad paints the stone (texture false). Eastern Han tomb-guardian type (stone lions are post-Qin; kept as designed).

req.prompt: A single Chinese Eastern Han dynasty stone guardian lion statue on a low rectangular plinth, seated upright, chest out, head turned slightly, bold simple carving with large curled mane, carved from one block of grey limestone, game prop, solid closed mesh
req.negative_prompt: text, people, multiple objects, thin spikes, floating parts, modern style, Qing dynasty ball under paw
